failure_summary.description: Search results were not bound and saved to cache in hotel and attraction plans.
Plans missed an actionable area or accepted hotel request, or refined a less relevant cached result.
A hotel star range was encoded as a singleton, and a flight date span and arrival-time limit were misencoded.
Plans imported runtime tools; one also repeated represented criteria, added an unrequested sort, and printed a no-op message after actions.

patch.reasoning: The common failures are already covered by the skill’s explicit rules for saving results, auditing conversation updates and cache compatibility, encoding exact ranges, and separating flight legs. Several prior edits targeting these same patterns were rejected, so adding redundant guidance is not warranted.
